modelspec.diagram.ScopeKey.title: ScopeKey
modelspec.diagram.ScopeKey.description: The canonical text of a scope path, unique within a graph and used as the composite node's key, an anchor on the documentation site and a file name (DESIGN.md § 13.2). The segments joined by `/`; a Program segment is the train block's name; a Stage segment its lower-case name; a Function segment `<fn>` for the first inlining of the function in the program and `<fn>@<c>` for inlining c from 1, the naming of dropout sites (DESIGN.md § 2.3); an Adjoint segment `grad%<k>`, k the forward ValueId; an Update segment `update@<parameter path>`.
